name: Digi Report
author: digiperforma.com.br

sections.description:
“Digi Report” is a simple and powerful tool for WordPress site administrators. It automates the collection of important data about site activity over the last month and sends a clear, professional report to the configured email addresses.

With this plugin, you can track:
* New posts and pages created.
* Posts and pages updated.
* Plugins that have been updated.
* WordPress core updates.

Simply set the day of the month for the report to be sent and keep your clients or team effortlessly informed about the site’s maintenance activities.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the digi-report folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ > ‘Reports’ to configure the destination email and the sending day.
sections.faq:
The email is not arriving, what should I do?

First, check if your server’s email sending settings are working correctly. You can use a plugin like “WP Mail SMTP” to configure an external sending service (like SendGrid, Gmail, etc.) to ensure reliable delivery.

Can I customize the email layout?

Currently, customizing the layout requires editing the main plugin file (digi-report.php).
